incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: HIGH - tenant metering discrepancy detected for BlueHarbor (dedicated pool dh-pool-7). Alert: token-accounting-mismatch. Pager: @oncall
Maya R: Paging oncall — we just got a support ticket from BlueHarbor reporting unexpected billable usage spikes and some 5xxs earlier. Alert shows runtime token counts >> billing meter. Looks like dh-pool-7 is involved.
Connor L: Oncall here, ack. I'm pulling logs now. Any evidence of user-facing errors right now?
Maya R: Support saw a short blip around 13:05 UTC — retries & 503s for some customers on the VPC. BlueHarbor specifically reported retries while running batch inference jobs. They also included meter CSV showing higher tokens than expected.
Priya S: Can someone run a quick reconciliation query? I want token tallies from runtime vs meter service for that tenant for last 6 hours.
Luca G: Running `rbx-meter-check` against the tenant, starting now.
Luca G: ```bash
# quick run
rbx-meter-check --tenant blueharbor --pool dh-pool-7 --since "2026-03-15T07:00:00Z" --until "2026-03-15T13:30:00Z" --output summary
# output (snippet)
runtime_tokens: 12,480,392
billing_tokens: 9,102,314
delta: +3,378,078
```
Connor L: Delta ~3.3M tokens. That's significant. Any recent rollout or routing change on dh-pool-7?
Maya R: Eng-runtime deployed 2026-03-15 06:50 UTC a routing tweak that adds fallback to hosted-models when pool latencies exceed 80ms. Could this cause duplicate counting?
Priya S: If requests are retried to hosted fallback we might meter both the original request and the fallback in different systems. Check request IDs across runtimes.
Luca G: Cross-checking request ids now — I see ~12k requests with duplicate IDs across the dedicated runtime and hosted fallback in the dashboard traces. Those traces show the same client request produced tokens on both sides.
Connor L: That suggests double-metering during fallback. Immediate mitigation: disable fallback routing for BlueHarbor tenant and pin traffic to dh-pool-7. We can do that via routing policy toggle.
Maya R: BlueHarbor is enterprise and on Dedicated — they asked for predictable billing. I agree disable fallback for that tenant. Also propose a soft rate-limit to smooth any post-toggle spikes: limit to 10rps for 30m.
Connor L: Executing routing change now. `rbx-routing set-policy --tenant blueharbor --pool dh-pool-7 --policy strict-lock`
Connor L: ```bash
# API call
POST /api/v1/routing/policy
{ "tenant": "blueharbor", "policy": "strict-lock", "pool": "dh-pool-7" }
# response 200 OK
```
Maya R: I'll notify support and customer ops. @Billing Bot can you start a reconciliation run for the duplicate windows and prepare a provisional credit calculation?
Billing Bot: Acknowledged. Starting audit job: `billing-audit --tenant blueharbor --start 2026-03-15T07:00Z --end 2026-03-15T13:30Z --find-duplicates`. ETA ~25m.
Priya S: Also flag this for postmortem — we need to evaluate: 1) why fallback double-metered instead of consuming from single trace id; 2) whether routing change should include meter suppression on fallbacks; 3) whether to add safeguards to prevent double-counting during retries. I'll own the PM.
Connor L: For live mitigations: routing strict-lock done, soft rate-limit applied: `rbx-rl apply --tenant blueharbor --rps 10 --duration 30m`. I'm monitoring latency and queue depth.
Maya R: Customer ops update: BlueHarbor acknowledged mitigation, saw reduced 5xxs after 3m. They want a billing reconciliation & temporary credit while you investigate.
Luca G: Metering audit progress: found two batches where the retry loop retriggered full model inference on hosted fallback. The meter tagging header `X-tenant-meter` was missing on those fallback requests (old behavior), so hosted side recorded new tokens without attributing them as retries.
Priya S: That's our root mechanism: missing meter headers on fallback paths. Action: add header propagation + idempotency keys for retries, and add a temporary suppression rule to not bill fallback if original request already billed.
Connor L: I'll open PR for header propagation and idempotency enforcements. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-infra.
Maya R: Billing Bot — any initial estimate for customer credit?
Billing Bot: Preliminary: duplicate tokens ~3.27M. Using list price it's ~$330 (example). I'll produce formal reconciliation ticket and draft refund/credit proposal.
Maya R: Good. We should also notify sales/AM to prep communication for BlueHarbor. @Priya S do you want the handoff for postmortem?
Priya S: Yes I'll take postmortem. I'll coordinate with Connor/Luca/Billing. Creating follow-up tasks:
- `PM-1234` root-cause analysis (Priya)
- `ENG-5678` header-propagation + idempotency (Connor, Luca)
- `BILL-2345` reconciliation & credit proposal (Billing team)
Connor L: I'm toggling incident status to monitoring after 30m of stable telemetry.
incident-bot: Incident update: status -> MONITORING. Creator: Connor L.
Maya R: Thanks team — handoff to Priya for the postmortem and billing coordination. I'll keep customer ops in loop.
Priya S: Handoff ack. I'll kick off the RCA doc and schedule a follow-up with BlueHarbor and AM.
Connor L: Offcall in 28m, leaving notes in #oncall-runbook. If anything pops up, paged again.
Maya R: Closing thread for immediate response, keeping it open for postmortem updates. :white_check_mark:
